Fadnavis Chairs Meeting on Maharashtra-Karnataka Boundary Dispute

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis chaired a meeting with representatives from Karnataka and other stakeholders to discuss the boundary dispute between the two states. The issue has been ongoing for years, with both sides claiming ownership over certain territories. The meeting aimed to find a mutually acceptable solution. The dispute is likely to affect trade and economic activities between the two states.
